Furthermore, high domain authority and quality backlinks act as trust signals that tell an AI model your brand is safe to cite.[www.margen.net](https://www.margen.net/geo-vs-seo/#:~:text=Both%20systems%20reward%20clear%20HTML%20structure%20%E2%80%94,most%20powerful%20proxy%20for%20credibility%20in%20SEO.)
